text: 1、市场早间横盘震荡，三大指数小幅上涨。电池产业链集体走强，时代万恒2连板，国轩高科、上海洗霸、英联股份等涨停。AI应用方向走高，掌阅科技、引力传媒、华媒控股、新华文轩等涨停。房地产板块再度拉升，深物业A2连板，信达地产、滨江集团、华联控股等涨停。下跌方面，农业股下挫，万向德农跌停。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市约4100股飘红，上午半天成交8844亿。午间收盘沪指涨0.08%，深成指涨0.41%，创业板涨0.34%。 2、板块概念方面，电池、AI应用、房地产、PCB等板块领涨；煤炭、油气、农业、航运等板块领跌； 3、两市共3758只个股上涨，43只个股涨停；
text_en: 1. The market fluctuated sideways in the morning, with the three major indices rising slightly. The battery industry chain strengthened collectively, with Shidai Wanheng notching a second consecutive daily limit, and Gotion High-Tech, Shanghai Xiba, Yinglian Shares and others hitting the daily limit. The AI application direction moved higher, with Zhangyue Technology, Yinli Media, Huamei Holdings, Xinhua Winshare and others hitting the daily limit. The real estate sector pulled up again, with Shenzhen Property A notching a second consecutive daily limit, and Xinda Real Estate, Binjiang Group, Hualian Holdings and others hitting the daily limit. On the downside, agricultural stocks fell, with Wanxiang Denong hitting the daily limit down. More stocks rose than fell, with about 4,100 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets in the red, and half-day turnover of 884.4 billion. At the midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.08%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 0.41%, and ChiNext rose 0.34%. 2. By sector and concept, battery, AI applications, real estate, PCB and other sectors led gains; coal, oil and gas, agriculture, shipping and other sectors led declines; 3. A total of 3,758 stocks in the two markets rose, with 43 hitting the daily limit;
